scenes.title: The number comes back
scenes.viewerPurpose: You run a study’s code and get the same result, but does its conclusion follow?
scenes.composition: A repeated numerical result sits beside a claim with one unexamined link.
addOrChange: Rename the report as a claim and show the links as a proposal, not implemented validation.

cues.visualAction: Show the rerun receipt matching the result, while a question remains beside the conclusion.
Bring the claim, data and code into one proposed connected record.

scenes.title: What makes the conclusion follow
scenes.viewerPurpose: The book proposes linking each claim to its data, assumptions, methods, and checks.
scenes.composition: A readable article is connected to data and method records.
addOrChange: Add an Assumptions note; avoid implying that code replaces interpretation.

cues.visualAction: Reveal the source records one at a time, each linked to the relevant claim.
Keep the article prominent while a short uncertainty note stays visible next to the code.

scenes.title: When evidence changes
scenes.viewerPurpose: If a source changes, researchers could follow which conclusions need another look.
scenes.composition: A changed source highlights the claims that depend on it.
addOrChange: Replace abstract graph labels with Source, Claim and Review; do not show unsupported accuracy gains.

cues.visualAction: Change one source record and mark its dependent conclusion for review, not automatic reversal.
Show the same AI icon selecting and checking evidence, then an independent check left open.

scenes.title: Follow the missing link
scenes.viewerPurpose: Its proposals invite builders and researchers to test a more careful kind of automated help.
scenes.composition: The claim and rerun record remain separated by a visible assumption check.
addOrChange: Relabel version tokens as result and claim records; preserve history without a long technical demo.

cues.visualAction: Bring a reviewer to the record history with an unfinished check still visible.
Hold the claim, assumption and result beside the book, leaving the reading question open.

checks: Do not generate voice until all122 script and visual plans pass review.
Use only source-grounded diagrams and neutral illustrative examples; preserve uncertainty and proposal labels.
Measure audio and keep the complete film at or below120 seconds without accelerating narration.
Inspect Color, Light and Dark at desktop and phone sizes; verify captions, labels and cue timing.
Listening review and visual QA are separate from having a compiled film.
